snapshot.text: Mixed system of Ministry of Health facilities, military Royal Medical Services, private hospitals and the King Hussein Cancer Center. Jordan aims for comprehensive health insurance coverage by 2030, and the government insures 4.1 million people for cancer treatment.

priorities.title: Comprehensive health insurance by 2030
priorities.text: The government's goal is health insurance for the whole population by 2030.

priorities.title: Cancer insurance
priorities.text: The government insures 4.1 million Jordanians for cancer treatment at the King Hussein Cancer Center, with JD 124 million allocated.
